name: Emergency & Crisis Stabilization Services (Hampshire County)
description: CSO's crisis team for Northampton/Hampshire County is staffed 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, for youth, families and adults. Crisis services are available regardless of insurance or ability to pay. Clinicians can do mobile crisis assessments at home, school, a clinical office or an emergency department.
contact: Hampshire County crisis line 413.586.5555; 8 Atwood Drive, Suite 101, Northampton, MA
